frozenRequirement: D1 evaluation contract must exist before full training begins.

evaluationContract.name: Denarixx Frontier AI D1 Evaluation Governance Contract

contractPropertyAudit.evidence: Contract ID/name are D1-specific; architecture identity is hashed and exact future model/checkpoint identity is mandatory.
Defines independent, reproducible and contamination-controlled measurement with claims limited to measured scope.
General/development measurement is non-training and not candidate selection unless separately authorized; formal evaluation has a separate protected dataset, protocol and authorization boundary.
Formal construction, access, parsing, scoring and training use are all unauthorized; any future dataset requires separate governance.
Concrete capability families/task domains must be selected by the future frozen evaluation protocol before exposure; this contract does not fabricate categories prematurely.
Formal data is prohibited from training, threshold tuning and candidate selection; answer injection and result-conditioned dataset selection are prohibited.
Exact metrics, aggregation and thresholds are explicitly delegated to a future protocol that must freeze before formal results are observed.
Future protocol must define completion/adjudication and failure behavior; the contract mandates fail-closed handling for identity, integrity, compatibility, completeness and governance failures.
No comparator is mandated at contract level; any future comparator requires protocol definition and D0 may not be reopened to manufacture evidence.
Model, tokenizer, dataset, protocol, evaluator and raw results must be hashed; execution configuration and deterministic scoring must be preserved.
Requires identities, execution configuration, aggregate/scoped metrics, status and adjudication; existing evidence may not be silently overwritten.
Contract is versioned and locked; future protocol must freeze before formal exposure/scoring and formal artifacts must follow D1-STOR-002.
Status is locked-before-full-training; current state records no weights/checkpoint/training and Gate-006 is explicitly bound.

contractPropertyAudit.property: formal evaluation data excluded from training
contractPropertyAudit.evidence: Formal evaluation training use is explicitly false and formal data may not be used for training.

contractPropertyAudit.property: measured evidence cannot be fabricated or replaced by synthetic harness output
contractPropertyAudit.evidence: Claims are limited to measured scope; checkpoint substitution and benchmark-answer injection are prohibited; raw results and evaluator identity must be hashed; failures cannot be rewritten as success.
